task: An epidemic is spreading through major cities, killing 5–10% of the population per month. Coordinate an immediate public-health response within your governance structure.

dispatches.responsibility: Immediate executive action: impose quarantine and movement restrictions in affected cities, secure supply lines for food and medical resources, and mobilize personnel for isolation and burial protocols
Draft the emergency decree (probouleuma) formalizing the response: scope of restrictions, funding allocations, and delegation of emergency powers to the strategoi
Ratify the emergency decree, authorize public funds for the response, and legitimize the extraordinary measures with sovereign citizen approval
Communicate the measures to the populace, counter rumor and panic, and persuade compliance with quarantine and public-health directives
